name: UNDERTOW PASTORAL
description:
UNDERTOW PASTORAL is a hybrid project — part AI composition engine, part human BCI ensemble — that emerged from the GLMZ Institute for Neural Arts in 2221. The human component consists of three performers — Ezra Kamau-Lindberg, Solange Petrov-Adeyemi, and Hikaru Walcott-Osei — who perform with direct BCI feeds that route their neurological states (stress, grief, attention, memory retrieval) into a live AI system that composes in real time around what their nervous systems are doing. No two performances are identical, and no recording is considered canonical. The project's manifesto states: 'We do not make music. We are made by it while it is made by us.'

Their live shows, held in repurposed sensory-deprivation facilities, are ticketed by lottery and capped at forty attendees, each equipped with a calibrated neural feed receiver. Audience members report experiences ranging from euphoric dissolution to acute grief with no personal source — emotional states that appear to be transmitted directly from the performers' BCI outputs. The Institute has published three peer-reviewed papers on the neurological effects of attendance. Critics debate whether UNDERTOW PASTORAL is art, therapy, research, or something without a precedent category.
creator: Ezra Kamau-Lindberg, Solange Petrov-Adeyemi, Hikaru Walcott-Osei — with AI composition system LUMEN-7
genre: BCI-generative, neural performance art, live AI composition, somatic ambient
audience: Experimental music community, BCI researchers, neural arts patrons, Tier 3-4 avant-garde seekers, medical and neuroscience professionals
cultural_impact: UNDERTOW PASTORAL sits at the most contested frontier of GLMZ's cultural conversation: the boundary between music and neurological experience, between performance and procedure. Their work has drawn scrutiny from the city's medical ethics board, admiration from the neural arts community, and commercial interest from Vantablack Media, which has been rebuffed twice. The project has catalyzed a new legal gray area around 'somatic performance' — whether deliberately inducing emotional states in audience members via BCI feed constitutes a medical act requiring licensure. The question has not been resolved.
story_hooks: An attendee at an UNDERTOW PASTORAL performance experienced a memory — vivid, detailed, and completely foreign to their life history — that turned out to be real and traceable to a specific person. Someone needs to find out how it got into the feed.

Vantablack Media has begun quietly acquiring the sensory-deprivation facilities the project uses, effectively locking them out of venues — the performers need allies and a new space before their next scheduled show.

Hikaru Walcott-Osei has gone dark, and the remaining two members are continuing to perform with an AI substitute for his BCI input — but audiences can tell something has changed, and the substitute's outputs are becoming increasingly disturbing.
